input.body:
**PR #2 was merged into `main` without approval from anyone other than the author (2 commits, D2).**

**What I did**
- Branch protections (P1–P6) all **pass** already, so I didn't change any settings and didn't run verify_repo.
- Retro-review issues for the 2 commits. Both were **already open** from an earlier run, so I didn't open duplicates:
  - `599d9a1` (merge of PR #2): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/5
  - `46d465d` (docs: add test instructions to README): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/6

**What you need to do**
Get someone who isn't the author to review both commits, then record the result and close issues #5 and #6. They are the audit record for CM-01 / SOC 2 CC8.1.

FYI: a 1-approval rule was in place (P2 passes), but the PR still merged without an independent approval. You may want to check whether the approval came from the author or an automated account (one commit is authored by `claude`).
